app.name: TimeLion
language.label: Language
home.title: Find a date together – without giving away your data
home.lead: TimeLion is a simple, open-source tool for scheduling polls. Polls are encrypted in your browser: the server never learns what they are about or who voted.
home.features.title: What makes TimeLion different
home.feature.encrypted.title: End-to-end encrypted
home.feature.encrypted.text: The key lives in the link and never leaves your browser.
home.feature.noAccount.title: No account, no cookies
home.feature.noAccount.text: No sign-up, no tracking, no ads, no third parties.
home.feature.expiry.title: Deletes itself
home.feature.expiry.text: Every poll has an expiry date and is permanently deleted afterwards.
notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.text: This page does not exist. Check the link or go back to the start page.
create.title: New poll
create.lead: Everything you enter here is encrypted in your browser before it is sent.
form.title: Title
form.datesHint: Pick one or more days in the calendar. Without a time, the whole day counts.
form.expiryHint: After this day the poll and all its responses are permanently deleted. It can be at most one year from today.
form.copyTimes: Use these times for all days
form.timesCopied: The times now apply to all days.
form.timezoneHint: All times are in this time zone. It is shown with the poll.
form.error.tooManyOptions: A poll can have at most 100 dates.
form.error.expiryInvalid: Pick today or a later day as the expiry date.
form.error.expiryTooLate: The expiry date can be at most one year from today.
form.error.endEqualsStart: The end is the same as the start.
form.error.duplicateTime: This time is already on this day.
error.network: The server can't be reached. Check your connection and try again.
error.rateLimited: Too many requests in a short time. Wait a while, then try again.
error.notFound: This poll doesn't exist (any more). It has expired or was deleted.
error.pollClosed: This poll is closed. Responses can no longer be changed.
error.tooManyResponses: This poll has reached the maximum number of responses.
error.tooLarge: The poll is too large. Shorten the texts or remove some dates.
error.invalidExpiry: The expiry date was not accepted. Pick an earlier date.
error.unreadable: The link is incomplete or wrong: the key in it doesn't decrypt the poll.
error.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
share.title: Your poll is ready
share.lead: Share the participant link with everyone who should vote. Keep the admin link to yourself.
share.warning: The poll's key exists only in these links; the server doesn't know it. If a link is lost, nobody can recover it, not even us.
share.participantHint: Anyone with this link can see the poll and vote.
share.adminHint: With it you edit, close or delete the poll. Don't pass it on.
copy.selected: The link is selected. Copy it with Ctrl+C or ⌘C.
poll.title: Poll
poll.noKey.title: The link is incomplete
poll.noKey.text: This link is missing its key, the part after the #. Without it the poll can't be opened. Ask the person who sent you the link for the complete link.
poll.unreadable.title: The link is incomplete or wrong
poll.unreadable.text: The key in this link doesn't decrypt the poll. Check that you copied the whole link.
poll.notFound.title: Poll not found
poll.notFound.text: This poll doesn't exist (any more): it has expired or was deleted.
poll.network.title: No connection
poll.network.text: The server can't be reached. Check your connection and try again.
poll.generic.title: Something went wrong
poll.generic.text: The poll could not be loaded. Please try again.
poll.closed: This poll is closed. Responses can no longer be added or changed.
poll.skipped: Unreadable responses: {count}. They are not shown.
results.title: Responses ({count})
results.caption: Votes: dates in columns, participants in rows
vote.title: Your response
vote.name: Your name
vote.saved: Thank you! Your response is saved.
admin.title: Manage poll
admin.lead: You see this section because you opened the admin link.
admin.statusOpen: The poll is open: everyone with the link can vote.
admin.statusClosed: The poll is closed: nobody can vote or change responses any more.
admin.finalHint: The chosen date is shown to everyone at the top of the poll.
admin.deleteHint: Deletes the poll and all its responses immediately and permanently.
admin.deleteQuestion: Really delete the poll for good?
error.forbidden: The admin link is not valid. Check that you copied the whole link.
poll.deletedText: The poll and all its responses were permanently deleted. It was also removed from this browser.
admin.editHint: Change the title, description, location, dates, time zone and expiry date.
edit.title: Edit poll
edit.warning: You are removing dates that people already voted on ({count}). Their votes for them will be deleted:
edit.saved: The changes to the poll are saved.
